title: Mask a systemd service to prevent it from starting
summary: Prevent a service from starting, even if another service tries to start it. This is stronger than disabling.

steps.explain: Mask the service so it cannot be started manually or by dependencies.

placeholders.name: SERVICE_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the systemd unit.

steps.expect: Output confirming the symlink was created.

rollback.explain: Unmask the service to allow it to be started again.

placeholders.name: SERVICE_NAME
placeholders.description: The name of the systemd unit.

warnings: Masking a critical service can break other services that depend on it. Use with caution.
